an4.41:1.3: Atthi bhikkhave samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārāya saṃvattati,
an4.41:1.4: atthi bhikkhave samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ñāṇadassanapaṭilābhāya saṃvattati,
an4.41:1.5: atthi bhikkhave samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satisampajaññāya saṃvattati,
an4.41:1.6: atthi bhikkhave samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattati. 2.
an4.41:2.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā diṭṭhadhammasukhaviharāya saṃvattati?
an4.41:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.41:2.3: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave samādhibhāyanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā diṭṭhadhammasukhaviharāya saṃvattati. 3.
an4.41:3.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ñāṇadassanapaṭilābhāya saṃvattati?
an4.41:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ālokasaññaṃ manasikaroti divāsaññaṃ adhiṭṭhāti
an4.41:3.3: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā.
an4.41:3.4: Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
an4.41:4.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave samādhibhāvanā . . . satisampajaññāya saṃvattati?
an4.41:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno viditā vedanā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti,
an4.41:4.3: viditā saññā . . . pe . . . viditā vitakkā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
an4.41:4.4: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave samādhibhāvanā . . . satisampajaññāya saṃvattati. 5.
an4.41:5.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave samādhibhāvanā . . . āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattati?
an4.41:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcupādānakkhandhesu udayavayānupassī viharati
an4.41:5.3: iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthagamo,
an4.41:5.4: iti vedanā iti vedanāya samudayo iti vedanāya atthagamo,
an4.41:5.5: iti saññā iti saññāya samudayo iti saññāya atthagamo,
an4.41:5.6: iti saṅkhārā iti saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo iti saṅkhārānaṃ atthagamo,
an4.41:5.7: iti viññāṇaṃ iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthagamo.
an4.41:5.8: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattati.
an4.41:5.10: idañ ca pana m' etaṃ sandhāya bhāsitaṃ Pārāyane Puṇṇakapañhe. 6.
an4.41:6.2: yass' iñjitaṃ n' atthi kuhiñci loke
